ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) and 25% high-intensity (white/cream), with high-intensity pixels localized to the distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and proximal regions consist of a solid low-intensity black mass. The distal left lobe contains a white geometric patch with dark speckling. The distal right lobe contains a larger white region intersected by vertical dark streaks and marginal mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle; depth is approximately 15% of total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude varies from 3 to 15 pixels, creating a jagged, non-linear boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the medial trailing edge transitioning to a slight convexity at the distal tips; overall sweep is broad and elongated.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white/grey bumps (barnacles) localized along the trailing edge serrations, most prominent on the far right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of vertical, parallel low-intensity linear marks observed on the high-intensity white patch of the right lobe distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Trailing edge exhibits irregular marginal tissue loss consistent with cumulative physical trauma or barnacle attachment scarring; noticeable indentation on the upper margin of the left lobe.
